explanations.title: Motor drive alarm reported
explanations.summary: An alarm was recorded for this motor channel. The drive's own diagnostic code and fresh observations are needed to identify the cause.

observations.name: drive_alarm
observations.text: Reported drive alarm: true. This is a reported indication, not an independent measurement.

observations.name: velocity
observations.text: Commanded velocity: 82 mm/s. This is a request, not measured behavior.

machine_response.summary: Actual machine response is unavailable: no fresh valid measured response was supplied. Faults, inhibit requests and zero-valued samples do not establish whole-machine rest, retained position or restart permission.

checks.title: Read the drive's diagnostic code
checks.detail: Record the exact drive model and its displayed alarm code, then consult its approved manual. An alarm alone does not identify a wiring or mechanical cause.

checks.title: Review the events around the alarm
checks.detail: Compare fresh measured feedback with command history. Commanded velocity does not establish actual movement.

checks.title: Verify the alarm path
checks.detail: Under the approved power-off service procedure, compare the alarm harness and configured polarity with the exact machine documentation. This explanation supplies no physical pin assignments.

checks.title: Use the reviewed recovery procedure
checks.detail: A cleared fault or restored configuration does not verify position, restore homing or authorize restart. Complete the required independent checks before a deliberate restart.

resource.label: Y · M3 (logical M2)
resource.service_guidance: Soldered FPGA and I/O regions are serviced through motherboard repair or whole-motherboard replacement. An external motor drive or load is a separate component.

wiring.required_reference: Exact approved machine wiring and equipment profile; not supplied by this explanation
